# config

```go
import "github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/internal/config"
```

Package config loads segredium's YAML configuration with SEGREDIUM\_\* env overrides.

Each section lives in its own file: server.go, storage.go, auth.go, tls.go, rotation.go. Every section type implements defaults\(\) and applyEnv\(\); this file only composes them.

## type [ServerConfig](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/config/server.go#L9-L24>)

ServerConfig: listeners, identity and logging.

```go
type ServerConfig struct {
    // HTTPSAddr is the TLS listener clients reach through /etc/hosts (default ":443"; "" disables).
    HTTPSAddr string `yaml:"https_addr"`
    // HTTPAddr is an optional plain-HTTP listener for AWS_ENDPOINT_URL style use ("" disables).
    HTTPAddr string `yaml:"http_addr"`
    // AccountID is the 12-digit account every ARN is minted for.
    AccountID string `yaml:"account_id"`
    // DefaultRegion is used when neither the SigV4 scope nor the Host header names a region.
    DefaultRegion string `yaml:"default_region"`
    // LogLevel: debug|info|warn|error.
    LogLevel string `yaml:"log_level"`
    // AccessMode: "machine" (default: the machine is the trust boundary, every local caller
    // may access every secret) or "owner" (a secret is accessible only to the Unix user that
    // created it, and to root; callers whose user can't be determined are denied).
    AccessMode string `yaml:"access_mode"`
}
```

StorageConfig: persistence and at\-rest encryption.

type StorageConfig struct {
    // Backend: "file" (default) or "memory".
    Backend string `yaml:"backend"`
    // Path contains one encrypted file per secret.
    Path string `yaml:"path"`
    // KeyFile defaults to <path>/master.key when empty.
    KeyFile string `yaml:"key_file"`

    PurgeInterval time.Duration `yaml:"purge_interval"`
}

<a name="TLSConfig"></a>
## type [TLSConfig](<https://github.com/nathabonfim59/segredium/blob/main/internal/config/tls.go#L11-L26>)

TLSConfig: the HTTPS listener's certificates.

```go
type TLSConfig struct {
    // Mode: "files" (CertFile/KeyFile) or "ca" (built-in CA).
    Mode     string `yaml:"mode"`
    CertFile string `yaml:"cert_file"`
    KeyFile  string `yaml:"key_file"`

    // CADir holds the built-in CA's root certificate (ca.crt.pem) and key (ca.key.pem).
    CADir string `yaml:"ca_dir"`
    // CACommonName is the root certificate's subject CN.
    CACommonName string `yaml:"ca_common_name"`
    // CAValidity is the root certificate's lifetime (YAML accepts "87600h" or nanoseconds).
    CAValidity time.Duration `yaml:"ca_validity"`
    // contains filtered or unexported fields
}
```
